decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree on both failures (LH-01 back ~13:30, LH-05 ~11:30). Este has 0 inflow and idle trucks (72 t/h), and E543-11 holds 285 t at 8.3 g/t. LH-08 is on the cheap infrastructure heading (0.2 oz/h) and reaches E543-11 in 0.55 h. At 23.6 t/h it loads about 150 t, roughly 40 oz, against about 1.4 oz of development lost. Norte is already truck-limited (inflow 71 vs 66 t/h), so covering N600-09 adds little. LH-09 is on a critical-path heading (4 oz/h), so I'm leaving it. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00, and LH-05 will likely be back by then, so I'm not using it.
